web-guide-idea-40.audience: Learners overwhelmed by a syllabus or project deadline.
web-guide-idea-40.offer: Help turn a large workload into an achievable next week. The person pays for guided planning and accountability, not someone doing the work.
web-guide-idea-40.steps.0: List deadlines and available study time.
web-guide-idea-40.steps.1: Break the material into small tasks and place them in a realistic schedule.
web-guide-idea-40.steps.2: Agree how to check progress and adjust when a day goes wrong.
web-guide-idea-40.equipment: A phone, notebook or simple calendar. No specialist software is necessary.
web-guide-idea-40.returnReason: Review what actually happened after a week and revise the plan, rather than selling the same timetable again.
web-guide-idea-40.promotion: Show a fictional weekly plan and explain how you adapt it around the learner’s commitments.
web-guide-idea-40.metadataTitle: Study Planning Session — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-40.metadataDescription: Help someone break their syllabus or project into smaller tasks and a realistic study schedule. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
